fund_name: Clean Energy Transition Partnership Joint Call 2025
host: Innovationsfonden (Danish Innovation Fund) within the Clean Energy Transition Partnership
summary: The Clean Energy Transition Partnership (CETP) Joint Call 2025 is a transnational funding opportunity supporting research, development, and innovation projects that accelerate the clean energy transition towards climate neutrality by 2050. It targets large-scale international projects organized in consortia addressing seven thematic Transition Initiatives covering energy systems, power technologies, storage, heating and cooling, regional and industrial energy systems, and built environment integration. The total budget is approximately EUR 80 million gathered from multiple national and regional funding bodies under Horizon Europe.
eligible_applicants: Public and private sector partners from more than 30 countries
reporting_requirements: Project updates and financial reports according to funding agencies' guidelines
Compliance with Horizon Europe RDI reporting standards
